1981-2415-6559-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

792-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

512-5475-7287.easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5475-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

141-1070-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-2438.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-5220-6900-8095.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-5220-6900-8095.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-5220-6900-8095.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

997-1116-2738-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

573-4693-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

5078-6666-7913.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

5078-6595-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

1429-1477-6982.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

489-1621-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7725.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4276-5088-5686-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
4276-5088-5686-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
4276-5088-5686-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

855-1806-2060-4050-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

57-4742-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4742-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

651-1946-3588.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}.
Task Force triggers, giving it +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.

2523-5147-5297.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

511-817-3000-4050-5902.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Squirrel and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1981-4416-6719-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-6719-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-3327-4613-5805.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-5805.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

856-2921-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2921-4321-6462.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4659-4853-4888-5115.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3391-4050-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {B}.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

575-1207-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

678-5147-5674--40.description:
Cast the creature that causes you to get energy counter(s) when it enters the battlefield by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When the creature enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get at least {E}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1393-2511-4986-5034--18.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Aether Channeler, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=1 by paying at most {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Aether Channeler, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-891-1585-2523.easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
413-891-1585-2523.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

486-2247-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Teferi has at least six loyalty counters on it.
486-2247-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Teferi to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Teferi to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

1339-1940-2899.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-1940-2899.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Liliana triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

708-2210-2459-5147.notablePrerequisites: Mirrormade is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2210-2459-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

3957-4702-5213.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
Trespasser's Curse attached to yourself.
3957-4702-5213.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Trespasser's Curse, gaining you 1 life and losing you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
